name: Vitreous-Cwm
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past binary sunset (multiple suns), mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

The air carries dust and something faintly floral, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on titanium are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
